description: This source file defines a GlossaryEntry struct and a LoadGlossary function for reading and parsing a glossary JSON file, used for handling glossary entries consisting of source-target pairs.

methods.name: LoadGlossary
methods.description: Reads a file containing glossary entries in JSON format and parses them into a slice of GlossaryEntry structs, handling errors such as file non-existence and JSON parsing failures.
